summary: Dream Finders Homes filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on November 5, 2026, announcing early participation results as of 5:00 p.m. New York time on November 4, 2026, for its private exchange offers and related consent solicitations. The company is exchanging any and all outstanding Beazer Homes 7.500% Senior Notes due 2031 and 8.000% Senior Notes due 2032—Beazer is now a wholly owned Dream Finders subsidiary—for new Dream Finders Notes. Consents seek indenture amendments. Offers run solely under the October 22, 2026 exchange statement to eligible QIBs and non-U.S. persons. Watch early-tender thresholds, consent delivery, and any extension or proration risk.
